Decision: - FastMCP version - STAY on 3.2.4, positive reason not inertia. ProxyInitializeMiddleware (new in 3.4.0, VERIFIED ABSENT from 3.2.4) calls client_factory at session-initialize and fails the WHOLE MCP session on upstream failure. That kills reconnect_required for un-onboarded users - the exact users it exists to serve. On 3.2.4 the factory fires per tool call only. A bump is an onboarding-flow REDESIGN, not a version change, and invalidates Spike B.
- Spike A0/A1 split - A's stated PASS needs live NetSuite tokens (via Spike C, admin-gated), but the MECHANISM half needs nothing. A0 runs today vs a local echo-stub; A1 does the live confirm. Stops admin access from gating the whole Phase-0 gate.
- Git remote - single `origin` = Rev4nchist, no upstream. The global fork-always/origin-never rule is a continuous-claude convention and does NOT apply here (matches the sibling fourth-salesforce-mcp).
- Serena/codegraph deferred to Phase 1 - no .py exists yet; they activate after the mold clone.
- Left the ADR + mold pin comment untouched - dated artifacts; CLAUDE.md supersedes them explicitly.

Blockers: - Admin access (sandbox + integration-record creation rights) gates Spikes C -> A1 -> B. Does NOT block A0 or D.
- Entra->NetSuite SAML federation unconfirmed with IT/Danny. SSO only - no API OBO exists; do not build a token exchange.

Next: - Spike A0 - build a minimal FastMCPProxy(client_factory=fn) vs a local echo-stub MCP server. PASS = (1) factory fires fresh per tool call, (2) get_access_token() resolves the caller inside it, (3) our injected bearer reaches the stub and the caller's Entra token does NOT. Needs zero external access. IS the Option A/B decision.
- Traps (verified in installed 3.2.4, don't rediscover) - never create_proxy() (no client_factory param; force-enables header forwarding even on a plain Client, proxy.py:755-762); use a plain Client not ProxyClient; the pattern is undocumented publicly - read source, not docs.
- Spike D (Cosmos ETag-CAS lock + capped counter) can run in PARALLEL with A0 - needs only a dev Cosmos instance. SF-MCP already uses Cosmos.
- If A0 fails - hand-rolled MCP client (as Salesforce did) or Option B. No amount of admin access saves Option A if A0 fails.
- Then, admin-gated: Spike C (both-scope OAuth + refresh-replay test + measure the MCP request multiplier) -> A1 (live confirm, distinct users in the AI Connector execution log) -> B (reconnect_required rendering in Claude).
- Phase 1 (clone the mold) follows the A/B decision. Note the mold has grown reporting/ + feedback/ subsystems the blueprint's map predates - triage at clone time.
